architectural_hypothesis.failure_consequence: If verified, no existing Job-39 architecture can answer the owner's state-conditioned direction/contract-choice question; a next policy must contain an explicit state-by-contract interaction
numerical_proof: reconstruct every stored OOF score as state_offset + contract_node_contribution
require the state offset to be constant within every session-minute
require full-score and contract-node argmax identity on every minute
architectural_hypothesis.statement: The linear ContractHead is additive in [state,node], so every candle, clock, account and global-ladder state contributes one common offset to all contracts in a routed minute. Contract score differences and the call/put/strike argmax depend only on the contract node and role head.

classification_rules.architectural_separability: all four numerical proof conditions pass
classification_rules.early_entry_collapse: at least 75% of activated sessions first cross during 09:35--09:39

activation_drift.cells: all five frozen fold cutoffs applied only to their original OOF score blocks
activation_drift.severe_rule: cutoff exceeds every scored minute in at least 2 of 5 folds

state_channel_neutralizations.candle_state: replace the GRU terminal state by zero at the fitted fusion input
state_channel_neutralizations.explicit_clock: replace the five clock channels by their frozen all-entry-minute mean
state_channel_neutralizations.global_ladder_summary: replace the permutation-invariant ladder summary by zero while preserving contract nodes
state_channel_neutralizations.interpretation: descriptive fitted-model sensitivity, not causal economic importance

forbidden: read P&L, bid, exit value, MFE, MAE or any forward target column
evaluate a new threshold, rank target, selector, seed, architecture or horizon
report a profitable time, side, premium, delta or fold subgroup
use target correlation to choose an attribution result

population.law: The unchanged 150 OOF scored sessions and 423,053 real neural-four-head 120m contract predictions

purpose: Explain V5 fold concentration and opening-minute activation without reading P&L, fitting a new model, changing a selector, or choosing an economic subgroup

v1_pre_output_defect.cause: The V1 analyzer reconstructed normalized model logits but compared them with stored predictions expressed in SPX points
v1_pre_output_defect.repair: Multiply full score, state offset, contract-node contribution and all neutralized offsets by the frozen 30-point target scale
